prior.summary: New to this reviewed candidate catalogue and mechanism contrast; MC2023 prediction is prior, not first discovery.
prior.case_context: 2019 primary work explicitly treats hypothetical distorted YNbN2, so the composition is not newly predicted here. The dated YNbN2/YTaN2 search found no exact experimental superconducting R-3m YNbN2 benchmark. The proposed novel object is the matched Nb-for-Ta source-state hypothesis at stated scalar finite-grid approximation.

sources.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
Primary source study: conventional superconducting compounds

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: A concrete competing structure exists: Pilemalm et al. predict a distorted YNbN2 relative to the binaries, while their YTaN2 is unfavorable. Those different relaxed metrics/DFT methods are not the exact R-3m source state and are not imported as its hull energy. The source state is locally stable at Gamma and sampled path, so the prior supplies a falsifiable distortion/decomposition risk rather than automatic rejection. Nitrogen defects/order and suppressed magnetism remain possible; a reported ScMN2 semiconductor result is not assumed to be the exact YNbN2 metallic EPC phase.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0.023729741 eV/A, P=-0.003 GPa, full max stress=0.103 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.
unknowns: Experimental superconductivity in this exact state
Direct support for approximately 300 K at ambient pressure

proposed_contribution.intervention: Nb replaces Ta on the unique transition-metal layer, retaining the Y and two N roles. The actual volume rises 0.6563% and nearest Y-N, Nb-N and N-N responses are retained. The favorable lambda sign persists across all ten sigma values, with a favorable separate Eli mu=.1 comparison retained below. This is a coupled layer-chemistry/construction response, not a valence-to-mobile-n inference.
proposed_contribution.next_action: Compare the actual R-3m source to the published distorted YNbN2 ordering with identical composition/functional and test the lowest distortion channel; preserve the Nb/Ta matched pairing contrast. A stable local R-3m basin with persistent coupling gain supports screening; a barrierless symmetry-breaking distortion or vanished metallic pairing response opposes it.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
